candidate_selection_history: Exploratory crash-isolated probes attempted diameters above 50 mm and then scanned the limiting wet-oblate q=0.1 state. The candidate frozen ceiling was fixed at 19 mm because 19.5 mm violated this same criterion.
independence_limit: Both sides use the same PyTMatrix implementation and differ only in the PyTMatrix ndgs shape-integration resolution. This is numerical convergence evidence, not independent scattering validation.
post_pass_policy: A passing result freezes these solver and grid configs before LUT generation and held-out selection. Later held-out outputs may not tune the generated tables. Any failed rerun requires a separately retained report.
scope: Every Cartesian grid point in all five frozen property configs, including every declared particle, material, frequency, and radar-view node.
